'''Gar Vulway''' was a member of the [[Eternal Alliance]] specialized in the [[Alliance Special Investigator]] at some point<ref name="MalgusEscape" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> Vulway compiled a final report regarding [[Malgus's escape]]. The report stated that [[Darth Malgus]]'s escape was simple, but it was unclear if he was involved in planning it or knew that [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] would free him.<ref name="MalgusEscape" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gar Vulway was mentioned in "Malgus' Escape," a codex entry introduced in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
